papers.title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
papers.translated_title: 见微：用于视网膜病变分割的可变形对偶Mamba
papers.author: Chang Yu
papers.summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) lesions vary widely in shape, and microaneurysms (MAs) span only a few pixels. We hypothesize that modeling the spatial organization of lesion regions, with global context and shape-adaptive scanning, improves the segmentation of such small and irregular lesions. To test this, we propose D$^2$Mamba, which couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning. We evaluate it with five-fold cross-validation on the DDR dataset, comparing against representative segmentation baselines under an identical training protocol, and conduct ablations on each component. D$^2$Mamba achieved the best overall performance, with 33.87% mIoU, 2.99 percentage points above the strongest baseline. The largest gain appeared on MAs, the smallest and most easily missed lesions, where Dice improved by 10.06 percentage points. These results confirm our hypothesis that spatially adaptive state space modeling benefits tiny-lesion segmentation. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/PUREPANEL1/D2Mamba.
papers.translated_summary: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）病灶形状差异很大，微动脉瘤（MAs）仅跨越几个像素。我们假设，对病灶区域的空间组织进行建模，并结合全局上下文和形状自适应扫描，能够改善此类微小且不规则病灶的分割。为验证这一假设，我们提出D$^2$Mamba，它将非因果状态空间对偶性与可变形Mamba扫描相结合。我们在DDR数据集上通过五折交叉验证对其进行评估，在相同训练协议下与代表性分割基线进行比较，并对每个组件进行消融实验。D$^2$Mamba取得了最佳整体性能，mIoU为33.87%，比最强基线高出2.99个百分点。最大提升出现在MAs上，这是最小且最易被遗漏的病灶，其Dice提升了10.06个百分点。这些结果证实了我们的假设，即空间自适应状态空间建模有利于微小病灶分割。代码和预训练权重可在https://github.com/PUREPANEL1/D2Mamba获取。

papers.title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
papers.translated_title: 基于条件熵的证据深度学习用于青光眼检测
papers.author: Hai Siong Tan
papers.summary: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出一种新的条件熵函数，作为量化证据深度学习（Evidential Deep Learning, EDL）中预测不确定性的基础，用于从视网膜眼底图像中检测青光眼。利用 EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 和 RIM-ONE-DL 数据集进行验证，我们发现，由条件熵函数正则化的所提 EDL 模型所产生的不确定性估计，其校准误差显著低于 Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准以及基于 Dempster 不确定性的传统 EDL 框架。为进一步探究模型的可解释性，我们使用表示空间集中度的聚焦指数分析了 Grad-CAM 热图。与其他不确定性量化方法相比，EDL 模型在正确分类与错误分类眼底图像的指数分布之间表现出更大的分离度。特别是，假阴性对应于偏离视盘的局部 Grad-CAM 激活，这与视盘在青光眼评估中既有的临床重要性相一致。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，所提出的用于青光眼检测的 EDL 框架不仅提供了增强的不确定性校准，还呈现出更具生理一致性的可解释性。

papers.title: Nepali-English Code-Mixed Speech Recognition: Data Preparation and Adaptation of a Speech Foundation Model
papers.translated_title: 尼泊尔语-英语混合语码语音识别：数据准备与语音基础模型适配
papers.author: Jeevan Neupane
papers.summary: Nepali speakers regularly mix English words into conversation, but multilingual speech recognisers often struggle with language switches and the writing script used for English words. We study how to adapt SraVaani, a 449M-parameter hybrid TDT-CTC model, using a 172.8-hour corpus covering six Nepali speech domains. Its pretrained tokenizer does not support digits and several common symbols. Rather than replace it or discard these recordings, we generate Nepali and English readings for numbers and use zero-shot ASR output to select a plausible form. Full fine-tuning reduces test word error rate (WER) from 48.6% to 17.1%; a 12-epoch run reaches 16.3%, compared with 16.4% for fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo. Freezing the encoder increases WER to 25.5%, while excluding numeric clips raises WER on numeric test speech from 14.3% to 21.3%. We also evaluate on FLEURS using both its original references and mixed-script alternatives. The comparison shows that transcription conventions explain part, but not all, of the out-of-domain performance loss.
papers.translated_summary: 尼泊尔语使用者经常在对话中混入英语单词，但多语种语音识别器往往难以处理语言切换以及英语单词所使用的书写文字。我们研究如何利用一个涵盖六个尼泊尔语语音领域、时长为172.8小时的语料库来适配SraVaani——一个具有4.49亿参数的混合TDT-CTC模型。其预训练分词器不支持数字和若干常见符号。我们没有替换分词器或丢弃这些录音，而是为数字生成尼泊尔语和英语读法，并利用零样本ASR输出选择一种合理的形式。完全微调将测试词错误率（WER）从48.6%降至17.1%；运行12个轮次达到16.3%，而微调后的Whisper large-v3-turbo为16.4%。冻结编码器会使WER升至25.5%，而排除数字片段会使数字测试语音上的WER从14.3%升至21.3%。我们还使用FLEURS的原始参考文本和混合文字替代文本对其进行了评估。比较表明，转写惯例解释了域外性能损失的一部分，但并非全部。

papers.title: TMAL: Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
papers.translated_title: TMAL：用于曲线结构分割的拓扑保持多偏移亲和力学习
papers.author: Suho Han
papers.summary: Curvilinear structures such as retinal vessels and surface cracks need both pixel-level accuracy and structural continuity. Pixel-wise supervision does not model the connections between pixels, and topology-based losses still produce ordinary masks. Connectivity-based methods predict these connections directly, but they use binary connectivity targets over a fixed local range. Such labels give the same value to thin segments and to thick regions, and they cannot describe connections at larger offsets. To address these limitations, we propose Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning (TMAL). TMAL uses soft affinities that emphasize thin regions near the boundary, and it predicts directional affinities at several offsets to reach further. It then combines these affinities with weights that come from the decoder features, so local continuity and wider context are used together. An auxiliary segmentation branch adds region-level supervision and keeps the overlap accuracy high. On the retinal vessel dataset DRIVE and the crack inspection dataset DeepCrack, TMAL reaches the highest Dice, IoU, and clDice scores, and it greatly reduces the connected-component error $Δβ_0$. Code is available at https://github.com/suho-han/TMAL.
papers.translated_summary: 视网膜血管和表面裂缝等曲线结构既需要像素级精度，也需要结构连续性。逐像素监督不建模像素之间的连接关系，而基于拓扑的损失仍会产生普通掩码。基于连通性的方法直接预测这些连接，但它们在固定的局部范围内使用二值连通性目标。这类标签对细段和粗区域赋予相同的值，且无法描述更大偏移处的连接。为解决这些局限，我们提出拓扑保持多偏移亲和学习（TMAL）。TMAL 使用强调边界附近细区域的软亲和力，并在多个偏移处预测方向性亲和力以覆盖更远范围。随后，它将这些亲和力与来自解码器特征的权重相结合，从而同时利用局部连续性和更广泛的上下文。一个辅助分割分支增加区域级监督并保持较高的重叠精度。在视网膜血管数据集 DRIVE 和裂缝检测数据集 DeepCrack 上，TMAL 取得了最高的 Dice、IoU 和 clDice 分数，并大幅降低了连通分量误差 $Δβ_0$。代码可在 https://github.com/suho-han/TMAL 获取。

papers.title: Distribution Shift Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery using Machine Learning Models
papers.translated_title: 使用机器学习模型进行遥感影像中的分布偏移检测
papers.author: Abdullah Almansour
papers.summary: Remote sensing imagery acquired by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) supports wide range of applications; however, deploying machine learning (ML) models on resource-constrained aerial platforms introduces challenges beyond predictive accuracy, particularly when deployment data differ from the distributions observed during training. Such shifts are common in remote sensing due to geographic, sensor, seasonal, and other visual variations. A practical solution is to equip deployed models with mechanisms that detect emerging distribution shifts and support subsequent responsive actions. This paper presents an empirical case study of three open-source detection tools: (i) Alibi-Detect; (ii) NannyML; and (iii) PyTorch-OOD. Using cross-dataset remote-sensing shifts, we evaluate both detection effectiveness and computational latency of these tools. Our results reveal differences in detection behavior and processing cost across methods and implementations, highlighting trade-offs between detection capability and response-time. These findings motivate further work toward lightweight, and latency-aware monitoring mechanisms for resource-constrained systems.
papers.translated_summary: 无人机获取的遥感影像支持广泛的应用；然而，在资源受限的空中平台上部署机器学习模型所带来的挑战超越了预测精度，尤其是当部署数据与训练期间观察到的分布存在差异时。由于地理、传感器、季节及其他视觉变化，此类偏移在遥感中十分常见。一种实用的解决方案是为部署的模型配备能够检测新出现的分布偏移并支持后续响应行动的机制。本文呈现了对三种开源检测工具的实证案例研究：(i) Alibi-Detect；(ii) NannyML；(iii) PyTorch-OOD。利用跨数据集遥感偏移，我们评估了这些工具的检测有效性和计算延迟。我们的结果揭示了不同方法和实现在检测行为和处理成本上的差异，突显了检测能力与响应时间之间的权衡。这些发现推动了面向资源受限系统的轻量级、延迟感知监测机制的进一步研究。

papers.title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
papers.translated_title: 移动AI工厂：为你的移动设备构建专用语言模型
papers.author: Evan Li
papers.summary: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19$\times$ less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory.
papers.translated_summary: 运行在移动设备上的小型语言模型（SLM）可以保护用户数据隐私，并在无网络连接的情况下工作。但只有当针对目标任务进行微调、并按目标设备调整规模时，它们才能表现良好，而这一过程目前需要反复的专家调优。我们提出 Mobile AI Factory，一个智能体系统，可为给定任务和手机构建经过微调、量化的 SLM。给定任务规格和目标手机，一个编排器 LLM 决定是调优超参数、挖掘真实数据，还是生成合成样本，同时固定规则会回滚那些损害准确率的更改。该工厂从基座模型和量化方案中的小模型到大模型进行搜索，在搜索过程中自适应调整其准确率目标，并使用跨推理引擎和后端对目标手机进行真实测量。我们在十个任务和四部 Android 手机上评估 Mobile AI Factory。在未见过的测试集上，其端侧模型在五个任务上优于两个五样本前沿模型，最高领先 0.34，并在另外三个任务上与它们持平。在实体抽取任务上，其搜索与穷举训练全部 27 个模型变体的结果相差在 0.03 以内，而 GPU 时间少用 19 倍。手机测量也很重要：最佳配置因手机而异。在没有手机测量的情况下，Claude Opus 5.5 在获得完整硬件和模型规格后，在 25% 的简单和中等案例以及 60% 的困难案例中未能满足应用要求。代码见：https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory。

papers.title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
papers.translated_title: 暗物质：面向SDR到HDR视频重建的VAE感知HDR编码
papers.author: Donghoon Cha
papers.summary: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content. Latent diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for restoring missing detail, but their effectiveness is constrained by how HDR signals pass through the pretrained VAE. We find that common log-like encodings suppress low-luminance chromatic differences before generation, producing a dark-side collapse in the frozen-VAE latent. We introduce EquivFlow, a compact, invertible exposure-equivariant encoding that maps exposure changes to additive shifts while retaining a scale-independent chromatic component, without modifying the VAE. Encoding-level tests across pretrained image and video VAEs show that its exposure structure and deep-dark chroma transport persist across the tested hosts. Integrated into SDR-to-HDR video diffusion, EquivFlow delivers consistent chromatic-fidelity gains across the tested settings while retaining competitive reconstruction fidelity.
papers.translated_summary: SDR到HDR重建是一个不适定问题，需要在保留原始内容的同时恢复被裁剪的高光、被压暗的阴影和量化伪影。潜在扩散模型为恢复缺失细节提供了强大的生成先验，但其有效性受制于HDR信号如何通过预训练的VAE。我们发现，常见的类对数编码会在生成之前抑制低亮度色度差异，从而在冻结VAE的潜在空间中产生暗部塌缩。我们提出EquivFlow，一种紧凑、可逆的曝光等变编码，将曝光变化映射为加性偏移，同时保留与尺度无关的色度分量，且无需修改VAE。在预训练图像和视频VAE上的编码级测试表明，其曝光结构和深暗色度传输在所测试的主机上均得以保持。集成到SDR到HDR视频扩散中，EquivFlow在所测试的设置中带来一致的色度保真度提升，同时保持有竞争力的重建保真度。

papers.title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
papers.translated_title: 评估Transformer中的组合泛化：组合等价性与模块覆盖的作用
papers.author: Purva Pruthi
papers.summary: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.
papers.translated_summary: 组合泛化是分布外泛化的一种重要形式，定义为在一些模块组合（例如排序、过滤等函数）上训练，然后泛化到未见过的组合的能力。尽管已有大量实证工作评估Transformer中的组合泛化，但研究结果并不一致，因为评估往往在有限的、以临时方式定义的训练-测试划分上进行。通过系统评估，我们识别出训练-测试分布中强烈影响性能的两个关键方面：组合等价性和模块覆盖。我们表明，直接模型（仅在最终输出上训练）的表观性能主要来自利用组合等价性，即不同的模块序列归约为相同的端到端函数。当基准消除这些等价性时，性能显著下降，表明它们无法泛化到产生新颖端到端函数的已知模块组合。我们进一步证明，随着模块覆盖偏移增加（当模块在训练和测试之间出现在不同上下文中时），性能单调下降，影响直接模型和逐步模型（在中间和最终输出上训练）。这些发现对基准设计具有具体意义：包含组合等价性的基准可能导致对直接模型泛化能力的显著高估，而同时包含模块覆盖违规和组合等价性的基准可能加剧捷径学习。作为案例研究，我们展示了组合等价性对预训练模型Llama3-8B在编码基准LiveCodeBench中代码输出预测任务上泛化性能的作用。

papers.title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
papers.translated_title: 面向开放词汇场景图生成的推理感知关系表示学习
papers.author: Jiawei Xiao
papers.summary: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition and generalization to unseen predicates. To address these challenges, we propose RaRe, a reasoning-aware relational representation learning framework that transforms MLLM-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales into structured relation embeddings. Rather than using CoT only as an intermediate reasoning trace for final prediction, RaRe directly optimizes the rationale-derived representation space to improve inter-relation discriminability. Specifically, RaRe first aligns rationale embeddings with textualized relation descriptions through self-supervised contrastive learning, and then refines rationale generation with a specificity-oriented reinforcement learning objective that encourages semantically object-pair-specific relational evidence. Experiments on VG150 and PSG demonstrate improved category-balanced recognition over existing baselines, while the additional gains from learning vary across datasets and proposal settings. Code available at: https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe.
papers.translated_summary: 开放词汇场景图生成（OV-SGG）要求模型识别训练词表之外的视觉关系，然而现有方法往往依赖特定数据集的对象—谓词共现模式。在长尾分布和噪声对象定位下，这种依赖会导致有偏且纠缠的关系表示，限制了稀有关系的识别以及对未见谓词的泛化能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 RaRe，一个推理感知的关系表示学习框架，将 MLLM 生成的思维链（CoT）推理依据转化为结构化关系嵌入。RaRe 并非仅将 CoT 用作最终预测的中间推理轨迹，而是直接优化由推理依据导出的表示空间，以提升关系间的可区分性。具体而言，RaRe 首先通过自监督对比学习将推理依据嵌入与文本化关系描述对齐，然后以面向特异性的强化学习目标精炼推理依据生成，鼓励语义上针对特定对象对的关系证据。在 VG150 和 PSG 上的实验表明，相较于现有基线，类别均衡识别得到改善，而学习带来的额外增益因数据集和候选框设置而异。代码见：https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe。

papers.title: Simultaneous Near-Optimal Region Identification in Continuous Simulation Optimization: Minimax Complexity and Adaptive Sampling
papers.translated_title: 连续仿真优化中同时近最优区域识别：极小极大复杂度与自适应采样
papers.author: Yilin Zheng
papers.summary: Simulation optimization typically returns a single estimated optimal point. When decisions also depend on criteria evaluated independently of simulation, such as resource cost, the decision maker instead needs the set of designs whose expected performance lies within a tolerance of the optimum, often choosing the tolerance only after seeing the tradeoffs. We study how to identify these near-optimal regions on a continuous design space, simultaneously for all tolerances up to a prescribed maximum $T$, with region estimation error at most $η$. We show that region identification is not a by-product of optimization. Specifically, when $α>ν$, any procedure, even one given the optimal design in advance, needs at least $Ω\bigl(η^{-(2+d/ν)}\min\{1,KT^{d/α}\}\bigr)$ simulation evaluations, where $d$ is the dimension, $ν$ the smoothness, and $(K,α)$ the covering parameters that describe the geometry of the near-optimal designs. We propose SASORI, which returns an estimated optimal point and the regions for all tolerances from the same evaluations, matching this lower bound up to logarithmic factors. SASORI also achieves the optimal tradeoff between region estimation error and cumulative regret, and reduces to a minimax-optimal simulation optimization procedure at zero tolerance. Numerical experiments illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
papers.translated_summary: 仿真优化通常返回一个估计的最优点。当决策还依赖于独立于仿真评估的准则（如资源成本）时，决策者转而需要那些期望性能位于最优值容差范围内的设计集合，且往往在看到权衡关系后才选择容差。我们研究如何在连续设计空间上识别这些近优区域，同时对不超过给定最大值 \(T\) 的所有容差进行识别，区域估计误差至多为 \(η\)。我们表明区域识别并非优化的副产品。具体而言，当 \(α>ν\) 时，任何程序——即使预先给定最优设计——至少需要 \(Ω\bigl(η^{-(2+d/ν)}\min\{1,KT^{d/α}\}\bigr)\) 次仿真评估，其中 \(d\) 为维度，\(ν\) 为光滑度，\((K,α)\) 为描述近优设计几何结构的覆盖参数。我们提出 SASORI，它从相同的评估中返回估计最优点以及所有容差对应的区域，在对数因子范围内匹配该下界。SASORI 还在区域估计误差与累积遗憾之间实现了最优权衡，并在零容差时退化为极小极大最优的仿真优化程序。数值实验说明了我们所提方法的有效性。

papers.title: High-throughput light-sheet 3D microscopy of whole rodent brain microstructure for integration with MRI
papers.translated_title: 全脑啮齿动物脑微结构的高通量光片三维显微成像及其与MRI的整合
papers.author: Hanmer, J. M.
papers.summary: Whole-brain cellular mapping is essential for understanding how cellular architecture shapes brain organisation and function. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) provides whole-brain coverage but is only indirectly sensitive to cellular features, motivating integration with microscopy to improve the interpretation and specificity of microstructural MRI. Here, we present a scalable cross-resolution framework integrating 3D light-sheet microscopy (LSM) of intact rodent brains with diffusion MRI (dMRI) to bridge cellular and macroscopic brain imaging. By combining active tissue clearing and immunolabelling with accelerated LSM acquisition, we achieve multiplexed mapping of neuronal and glial populations across the whole brain on timescales comparable to conventional histology. We apply this framework across eight genetically diverse mouse strains to develop predictive models of microscopy-derived cellular features from multi-shell dMRI contrasts. Data-driven combinations of dMRI contrasts predicted neuronal and astrocytic features better than individual contrasts across animals. This framework enables scalable integration of MRI and 3D LSM, providing a means to identify cellular determinants of MRI contrast and guide the development and interpretation of microstructural MRI measures ultimately translatable to the living human brain.
papers.translated_summary: 全脑细胞图谱对于理解细胞构筑如何塑造脑组织与功能至关重要。磁共振成像（MRI）能够提供全脑覆盖，但仅对细胞特征具有间接敏感性，这促使将其与显微成像整合，以提高微结构MRI的解释性和特异性。在此，我们提出一个可扩展的跨分辨率框架，将完整啮齿动物脑的三维光片显微镜（LSM）与扩散MRI（dMRI）相结合，以桥接细胞与宏观脑成像。通过将主动组织透明化和免疫标记与加速LSM采集相结合，我们实现了在可与传统组织学相当的时间尺度上对整个脑内神经元和胶质细胞群体的多重图谱绘制。我们在八种遗传多样性小鼠品系中应用该框架，以从多壳dMRI对比中建立显微成像衍生细胞特征的预测模型。数据驱动的dMRI对比组合在跨动物预测神经元和星形胶质细胞特征方面优于单一对比。该框架实现了MRI与三维LSM的可扩展整合，为识别MRI对比的细胞决定因素提供了手段，并指导微结构MRI测量的开发与解释，最终可转化至活体人脑。

papers.title: Interconnected reservoirs of multidrug-resistant bacteria and plasmids within hospital plumbing infrastructure
papers.translated_title: 医院管道基础设施中多重耐药细菌与质粒的互联储库
papers.author: Annavajhala, M. K.
papers.summary: Hospital sinks and wastewater streams are hotspots for contamination and colonization with multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria (MDR-GNB). While hospital water systems may facilitate MDR-GNB transmission during outbreaks, longitudinal population dynamics of environmental MDR-GNB and their long-term relationship with patient isolates remain unclear. Here we aimed to characterize the diversity and abundance of MDR-GNB within the hospital built environment and evaluate their relationship with clinical isolates. We performed nanopore sequencing on MDR-GNB cultured from sink drains (n=523) and wastewater (n=146) at a New York City hospital between March-August 2023. We assessed spatial and longitudinal genomic strain and plasmid dynamics and quantified relatedness to historical clinical isolates from the same hospital (n=602). Sink drains (54-73%) and wastewater (100%) demonstrated widespread, longitudinal colonization with MDR-GNB, driven primarily by carbapenem-resistant GNB including opportunistic organisms and Enterobacterales encoding blaKPC. While bacterial colonization differed across environmental niches, we identified both MDR-GNB strains and resistance plasmids that were shared between clinical and environmental sources, as well a distinct interplay between clinical and wastewater versus sink drain samples. This study supports the role of hospital plumbing as an important reservoir for clinically relevant MDR-GNB, but highlights differences across environmental sources, which may impact surveillance approaches.
papers.translated_summary: 医院水槽和废水系统是多重耐药革兰阴性菌（MDR-GNB）污染和定植的热点。尽管医院水系统可能在疫情暴发期间促进MDR-GNB传播，但环境中MDR-GNB的纵向种群动态及其与患者分离株的长期关系仍不清楚。本研究旨在表征医院建筑环境中MDR-GNB的多样性和丰度，并评估其与临床分离株的关系。我们对2023年3月至8月期间纽约市一家医院的水槽排水口（n=523）和废水（n=146）中培养的MDR-GNB进行了纳米孔测序。我们评估了空间和纵向的基因组菌株及质粒动态，并量化了其与同一医院历史临床分离株（n=602）的相关性。水槽排水口（54-73%）和废水（100%）均表现出MDR-GNB的广泛纵向定植，主要由耐碳青霉烯类革兰阴性菌驱动，包括机会性病原体和携带blaKPC的肠杆菌目。尽管不同环境生态位的细菌定植存在差异，但我们鉴定出临床和环境来源之间共享的MDR-GNB菌株和耐药质粒，以及临床与废水样本和与水槽排水口样本之间不同的相互作用模式。本研究支持医院管道系统作为临床相关MDR-GNB重要储库的作用，但强调了不同环境来源之间的差异，这可能影响监测策略。

papers.title: Molecular Modulation of the SAM-I Riboswitch Drives Global Dynamical Shifts
papers.translated_title: SAM-I核糖开关的分子调控驱动全局动力学转变
papers.author: Nair, V.
papers.summary: A surge in antimicrobial resistance in recent years has made protein-targeting antibiotics less effective against key pathogens. It is possible to expand the range of therapeutic targets by using RNA-based therapies, but it remains necessary to improve the molecular-level understanding of interactions between RNA and known and potential binders. The SAM-I riboswitch, which controls the transcriptional termination of gene expression involved in sulfur metabolism in most bacteria, is an excellent ligand target. Thus, understanding its behavior with and without ligand complexes would be helpful for drug design. Here, we studied the interactions between the SAM-I riboswitch and its natural ligand, SAM, which controls riboswitch function, and compared those to its interactions with the similar small molecule SAH, which does not control riboswitch function, and to its interactions with a potential binder JS4, identified via virtual screening. From our simulations, we deepen understanding of small molecule interactions with the SAM-I riboswitch on both a local and a distal level. The results reveal how differently ligands (SAM, SAH and JS4) can bind to and potentially induce conformational changes in the riboswitch. Our findings offer valuable insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying riboswitch RNA-ligand interactions for the design of more effective RNA-targeting therapeutics.
papers.translated_summary: 近年来抗菌药物耐药性的激增使得靶向蛋白质的抗生素对关键病原体的效力下降。利用RNA疗法有可能扩大治疗靶点的范围，但仍有必要在分子水平上加深对RNA与已知及潜在结合物之间相互作用的理解。SAM-I核糖开关控制大多数细菌中参与硫代谢的基因表达的转录终止，是一个极佳的配体靶点。因此，了解其在有配体复合物和无配体复合物情况下的行为将有助于药物设计。在此，我们研究了SAM-I核糖开关与其天然配体SAM（控制核糖开关功能）之间的相互作用，并将其与类似小分子SAH（不控制核糖开关功能）的相互作用以及通过虚拟筛选鉴定出的潜在结合物JS4的相互作用进行了比较。通过我们的模拟，我们在局部和远端层面加深了对小分子与SAM-I核糖开关相互作用的理解。结果揭示了不同配体（SAM、SAH和JS4）与核糖开关结合并潜在诱导构象变化的方式差异。我们的发现为核糖开关RNA-配体相互作用的分子机制提供了有价值的见解，有助于设计更有效的RNA靶向治疗药物。

papers.title: Hybrid RY-mers increase aDNA alignment sensitivity
papers.translated_title: 混合RY-mer提高aDNA比对灵敏度
papers.author: Tolstoganov, I.
papers.summary: One of the key steps in ancient DNA data analysis is the accurate identification of endogenous short reads that originate from the ancient genome. Currently, this step is performed using general-purpose sequence aligners, such as BWA-aln, with parameter settings optimized for sensitivity. This approach results in increased runtime, even relative to standard DNA alignment workflows, and is not sufficient for aligning samples that are highly divergent from a reference database. We introduce hybrid RY-mers, a seed construct designed to incorporate aDNA-specific sequence damage. We adapt hybrid RY-mers to the existing concept of multi-context seeds and implement them in the read aligner strobealign. On simulated genomic and metagenomic datasets, we show that hybrid RY-mers result in higher mapping accuracy, while also reducing runtime by 4-6 times compared to the state-of-the-art aDNA alignment method BWA-aln. Furthermore, substituting aDNA aligner MALT in the metagenomic tool-suite aMeta with our new alignment approach demonstrated that aMeta gave a faster and less memory consuming detection of ancient taxa present in the samples.
papers.translated_summary: 古DNA数据分析的关键步骤之一是准确识别源自古代基因组的内源性短读段。目前，该步骤使用通用序列比对器（如BWA-aln）完成，其参数设置为优化灵敏度。这种方法导致运行时间增加，甚至相对于标准DNA比对流程也是如此，并且不足以比对与参考数据库高度分化的样本。我们引入混合RY-mers，这是一种旨在纳入aDNA特异性序列损伤的种子构造。我们将混合RY-mers适配到现有多上下文种子的概念中，并在读段比对器strobealign中实现它们。在模拟的基因组和宏基因组数据集上，我们表明混合RY-mers导致更高的比对精度，同时与最先进的aDNA比对方法BWA-aln相比，运行时间减少4-6倍。此外，在宏基因组工具套件aMeta中用我们的新比对方法替换aDNA比对器MALT表明，aMeta对样本中存在的古代分类群给出了更快且内存消耗更少的检测。

papers.title: Implicit Hierarchical Tensor Decomposition of Single-Cell Four-Omics Data Reveals Cell-Type-Linked Candidate Enhancer--Promoter-Associated Programs
papers.translated_title: 单细胞四组学数据的隐式层次张量分解揭示细胞类型相关的候选增强子--启动子关联程序
papers.author: Taguchi, Y.-h.
papers.summary: Single-cell multi-omics provides complementary views of gene regulation, but integrating modalities with natural features comprising enhancers, genes, and three-dimensional (3D) genomic loci remains challenging. This study developed an implicit hierarchical tensor decomposition framework and applied it to the CHARM single-cell four-omics mouse brain data (GSE303006) by jointly analyzing ATAC, H3K27ac, RNA, and reconstructed 3D enhancer--promoter (E--P) distances. After quality control, 730,969 E--P pairs, 42,669 enhancers, 16,239 genes, 391,435 20-kb bin pairs, and 4,258 cells were retained. Each modality was independently reduced to 20 components and mapped to an implicit 730,969x4{,}258x20x4 tensor, which was decomposed without materializing the full array. In a joint model, cell type explained more variance than biological replicate for all 12 distinct cell components represented among the 100 largest Tucker core elements. A representative core linked the Inh_Ndnf/Lamp5--Ex_L3/4_IT cell axis to contrasting presynaptic-transmission and developmental/morphogenetic candidate E--P-associated programs. Its E--P and cell factors were recovered when the whole analysis was repeated independently on each pair of replicates, and the E--P pairs it prioritized agreed in direction with the cell-type-resolved enhancer--gene links of the original CHARM study. No single modality reproduced the program, which required the combination of accessibility, chromatin contact, and expression. Backprojection showed reproducible ATAC, H3K27ac, and 3D effects across three biological replicates; RNA differed clearly for the developmental module but not for the presynaptic module. The framework thus identifies regulatory structure that is shared across molecular modalities and is not recoverable from any single modality.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞多组学为基因调控提供了互补视角，但整合包含增强子、基因和三维（3D）基因组位点等天然特征的模式仍具挑战性。本研究开发了一种隐式分层张量分解框架，并将其应用于CHARM单细胞四组学小鼠脑数据（GSE303006），联合分析ATAC、H3K27ac、RNA和重建的3D增强子—启动子（E—P）距离。经过质量控制，保留了730,969个E—P对、42,669个增强子、16,239个基因、391,435个20-kb bin对和4,258个细胞。每种模式独立降维至20个成分，并映射到一个隐式730,969×4,258×20×4张量，该张量在未物化完整数组的情况下进行分解。在联合模型中，对于100个最大Tucker核心元素中所代表的全部12个不同细胞成分，细胞类型解释的方差均多于生物学重复。一个代表性核心将Inh_Ndnf/Lamp5—Ex_L3/4_IT细胞轴与对比性的突触前传递和发育/形态发生候选E—P相关程序联系起来。当在每对重复样本上独立重复全部分析时，其E—P因子和细胞因子均可被恢复，且其优先排序的E—P对在方向上与原始CHARM研究中细胞类型分辨的增强子—基因链接一致。没有任何单一模式能够重现该程序，该程序需要可及性、染色质接触和表达的联合。反向投影显示ATAC、H3K27ac和3D效应在三个生物学重复中可重复；RNA在发育模块上差异明显，但在突触前模块上不明显。因此，该框架识别了跨分子模式共享且无法从任何单一模式中恢复的调控结构。

papers.title: Simple models outperform single-cell foundation models on downstream benchmarks
papers.translated_title: 简单模型在下游基准测试中优于单细胞基础模型
papers.author: Souza, H.
papers.summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data exhibit strong and reproducible statistical structure. This has motivated the development of large-scale foundation models, such as TranscriptFormer, that use transformer-based architectures to learn a generative model for gene expression by embedding genes into a latent vector space. These embeddings have been used to obtain state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on downstream tasks such as cell-type classification, disease-state prediction, and cross-species learning. Here, we ask whether similar performance can be achieved without utilizing computationally intensive deep learning-based representations. Using simple, interpretable pipelines that rely on careful normalization and linear methods, we obtain SOTA or near SOTA performance across multiple benchmarks commonly used to evaluate single-cell foundation models, including outperforming foundation models on out-of-distribution tasks involving novel cell types and organisms absent from the training data. Our findings highlight the need for rigorous benchmarking and suggest that the biology of cell identity can be captured by simple linear representations of single cell gene expression data.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据展现出强烈且可重复的统计结构。这推动了大规模基础模型的发展，例如TranscriptFormer，其采用基于Transformer的架构，通过将基因嵌入潜在向量空间来学习基因表达的生成模型。这些嵌入已被用于在细胞类型分类、疾病状态预测和跨物种学习等下游任务上获得最先进（SOTA）的性能。在此，我们探讨是否可以在不利用计算密集型深度学习表征的情况下实现类似的性能。使用依赖仔细归一化和线性方法的简单、可解释流程，我们在多个常用于评估单细胞基础模型的基准测试中获得了SOTA或接近SOTA的性能，包括在涉及训练数据中不存在的新细胞类型和生物体的分布外任务上优于基础模型。我们的发现凸显了严格基准测试的必要性，并表明细胞身份生物学可以通过单细胞基因表达数据的简单线性表征来捕捉。

papers.title: Large seed size accompanying GmSDP1 suppression is linked to cellular remodeling and phytohormone regulation
papers.translated_title: 大种子伴随GmSDP1抑制与细胞重塑和植物激素调控相关
papers.author: Mukherjee, T.
papers.summary: Soybean (Glycine max) seeds contain approximately 20% oil and 40% protein and are important for food, feed, and biofuel. Improving soybean productivity and seed quality requires optimizing carbon partitioning during seed development. Previously, seed-specific suppression of the lipase-encoding gene Sugar-Dependent 1 (SDP1) increased seed oil content by approximately 5% while slightly reducing raffinose family oligosaccharides without compromising protein content. Seed-specific SDP1 suppression also increased seed size by 18-25% without affecting seed number, resulting in greater seed biomass per plant. To determine the developmental basis of the increased seed size, we investigated the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying this phenotype. Microscopy and biochemical analyses showed that larger seeds were associated with increased seed cell size and enhanced lignocellulosic cell wall accumulation. Temporal biochemical and transcriptomic analyses further revealed coordinated changes in hormone homeostasis, including altered levels of abscisic acid, 12-oxo-phytodienoic acid, and jasmonoyl-isoleucine, together with differential expression of F-box and RING/U-box family genes. The results indicate that the enhanced seed size resulting from SDP1 suppression is associated with coordinated changes in cellular development, cell wall accumulation, hormone homeostasis, and regulation of gene expression during seed development. Developmental and metabolic changes associated with the increased seed size phenotype support SDP1 manipulation as a potential strategy for improving soybean seed yield and quality.
papers.translated_summary: 大豆（Glycine max）种子约含20%的油和40%的蛋白质，对食品、饲料和生物燃料具有重要意义。提高大豆生产力和种子品质需要优化种子发育过程中的碳分配。此前，种子特异性抑制编码脂肪酶的糖依赖性1（SDP1）基因可使种子含油量提高约5%，同时略微降低棉子糖家族寡糖而不影响蛋白质含量。种子特异性抑制SDP1还使种子大小增加18-25%而不影响种子数量，从而导致单株种子生物量增加。为确定种子大小增加的发育基础，我们研究了该表型背后的细胞和分子机制。显微镜和生化分析表明，较大的种子与种子细胞尺寸增加和木质纤维素细胞壁积累增强相关。时间序列生化和转录组分析进一步揭示了激素稳态的协调变化，包括脱落酸、12-氧代植物二烯酸和茉莉酰异亮氨酸水平的改变，以及F-box和RING/U-box家族基因的差异表达。结果表明，SDP1抑制导致的种子大小增加与种子发育过程中细胞发育、细胞壁积累、激素稳态和基因表达调控的协调变化相关。与种子大小增加表型相关的发育和代谢变化支持将SDP1操控作为提高大豆种子产量和品质的潜在策略。

papers.title: A Proteome-Wide Gain-of-Function Atlas Mapping the Landscape of Chemotherapy Response
papers.translated_title: 全蛋白质组功能获得图谱描绘化疗反应全景
papers.author: Jo, K. B.
papers.summary: Background: Conventional chemotherapies remain the core therapeutic backbone of cancer treatment, yet the rapid emergence of chemoresistance often compromises their clinical efficacy. Although large-scale functional genomics has transformed precision oncology, existing reference maps rely predominantly on loss-of-function paradigms and lack systematic data on gain-of-function (GOF) events that commonly drive clinical resistance. Methods: To address this gap, we engineered a site-specific Bxb1 integrase landing-pad system in HeLa cells, enabling single-copy integration of a human proteome-wide library [18,388 open reading frames (ORFs)] at the AAVS1 locus under a uniform EF1 promoter. We systematically profiled cellular fitness across 16 chemotherapeutics. We integrated this GOF perturbation screen with bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, FACS-based lysosomal functional screening, clinical cohort survival analyses, and preclinical xenograft modeling. Results: Stratified modeling of over 230,000 gene-drug interactions defined distinct functional categories that are strongly enriched for clinical cancer biomarkers and prognostic relevance. Global network analysis and organelle-specific lysosomal functional screening uncovered that chemotherapeutic agents, most prominently the nucleoside analog TAS-102 (Lonsurf), converge upon a shared survival hub centered on the BCL-2 family-associated autophagy-endolysosomal network. Mechanistically, TAS-102 triggered lysosomal activation as an adaptive survival response. Co-treatment with the BCL-2 family inhibitor ABT-263 (Navitoclax) attenuated this TAS-102-induced lysosomal response and synergistically reversed TAS-102 resistance across colorectal and pancreatic cancer models in vitro and in colorectal cell line- and patient-derived xenograft (CDX, PDX) models in vivo. Conclusions: Our study establishes an open-access, proteome-wide GOF reference atlas that systematically maps chemotherapeutic responses, recapitulates canonical resistance biology, and nominates rational drug combinations. This systems-genomics resource bridges massive-scale perturbation mapping with actionable target discovery, providing a translational framework to overcome therapeutic resistance and reprogram cancer drug responses.

papers.title: Shared experimental materials inflate and reorder cross-participant decoding benchmarks
papers.translated_title: 共享实验材料会膨胀并重排跨参与者解码基准。
papers.author: Cui, H.
papers.summary: Decoding mental states from brain activity underpins brain-computer interfaces and cognitive neuroscience. Decoders are judged by how well they generalize to people left out of training, taken as evidence that they capture what transfers between brains. However, most benchmarks present the same experimental materials to every participant, so held-out participants are tested on materials the model has already seen. Here we show, across 15 EEG, fMRI and eye-tracking datasets and 318 matched comparisons, that shared materials inflate cross-participant accuracy by up to 46 percentage points. They also reorder methods, reversing the advantage of foundation models over handcrafted features on the largest emotion EEG benchmark. The inflation tracks cross-participant item identifiability and, in sealed prospective tests, vanished where items could not be identified. Adding training items improved new-material accuracy more reliably than adding participants. These findings call for reporting new-material accuracy alongside conventional scores and for measuring item identifiability first.
papers.translated_summary: 从大脑活动中解码心理状态是脑机接口和认知神经科学的基础。解码器的评判标准是其在未参与训练的人群上的泛化能力，这被视为解码器捕捉到了大脑之间可迁移内容的证据。然而，大多数基准测试向每位参与者呈现相同的实验材料，因此留出参与者的测试材料是模型已经见过的。本文通过15个EEG、fMRI和眼动追踪数据集以及318组匹配比较表明，共享材料会使跨参与者准确率虚高最多46个百分点。共享材料还会改变方法排序，在最大的情绪EEG基准上逆转了基础模型相对于手工特征的优势。这种虚高与跨参与者项目可识别性相关，并且在密封的前瞻性测试中，当项目无法被识别时，虚高消失了。增加训练项目比增加参与者更能可靠地提高新材料准确率。这些发现要求除常规得分外还应报告新材料准确率，并首先测量项目可识别性。

papers.title: Widespread oscillatory suppression in autism persists in the absence of psychotropic medication.
papers.translated_title: 自闭症中广泛的振荡抑制在缺乏精神药物的情况下持续存在。
papers.author: Amorim, A. K. J.
papers.summary: Purpose: Investigate the neural oscillatory activity associated with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) using electroencephalographic (EEG) recordings in children and adolescents. Compare the corresponding oscillatory power between ASD patients taking psychotropic medication with a drug-naive group. Methods: ASD diagnosis was done using DSM-IV and CARS (Childhood Autism Rating Scale). EEG recordings employed 22 scalp electrodes (10/20 system). ASD vs. neurotypical groups were matched for sex and age (5 females; average age: ~10 years old). We analyzed the resting state (eyes open) EEG power spectrum during ~2-minute recordings. The multitaper FFT method was used to estimate spectral power for the delta, theta, alpha, beta and gamma frequency bands. We pooled together data from several electrodes to compute comprehensive power spectra and assess the oscillatory behavior of macro brain regions. Results: We observed widespread (~4Hz - 20Hz) oscillatory suppression comprising the theta, alpha and beta frequency bands. The most widespread and robust ASD-associated power suppression was in the high theta and alpha bands. Delta and gamma bands showed no significant power change for any of the brain regions studied. Results from a subgroup of patients (N = 9) who never used psychotropics confirmed these findings, indicating that they are not an artifact of medication. Conclusion: Suppression in theta, alpha and beta oscillations may offer insights into the neurophysiological underpinnings of autism and could be used as an accessible and comprehensive tool in ASD diagnosis, regardless of the patients being or not on medication.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：利用儿童和青少年的脑电图记录，研究与自闭症谱系障碍相关的神经振荡活动。比较服用精神药物的自闭症谱系障碍患者与未用药组的相应振荡功率。方法：自闭症谱系障碍诊断采用DSM-IV和CARS（儿童自闭症评定量表）进行。脑电图记录使用22个头皮电极（10/20系统）。自闭症谱系障碍组与神经典型组在性别和年龄上匹配（5名女性；平均年龄约10岁）。我们分析了约2分钟记录期间的静息状态（睁眼）脑电图功率谱。采用多锥度FFT方法估计delta、theta、alpha、beta和gamma频段的频谱功率。我们汇总了多个电极的数据以计算综合功率谱，并评估大脑宏观区域的振荡行为。结果：我们观察到广泛的（约4Hz-20Hz）振荡抑制，涵盖theta、alpha和beta频段。最广泛且最稳健的自闭症谱系障碍相关功率抑制出现在高theta和alpha频段。delta和gamma频段在所研究的任何脑区均未显示显著功率变化。从未使用精神药物的患者亚组（N=9）的结果证实了这些发现，表明它们不是药物造成的伪影。结论：theta、alpha和beta振荡的抑制可能为自闭症谱系障碍的神经生理学基础提供见解，并可作为自闭症谱系障碍诊断中一种可及且全面的工具，无论患者是否正在服药。

papers.title: Digital journaling enables privacy-preserving behavioral phenotyping and real-time risk monitoring at scale
papers.translated_title: 数字日记使隐私保护的行为表型分析和大规模实时风险监测成为可能
papers.author: Milham, M.
papers.summary: Background: Digital journaling may serve both as a low-intensity mental health intervention and as a source of longitudinal behavioral data. Its clinical effects and its potential for privacy-preserving behavioral phenotyping and risk-signal characterization require separate evaluation. Objective: This study evaluated the clinical effects of guided and unguided digital journaling and explored whether longitudinal journaling data could characterize reproducible patterns in mood and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. Methods: Part I was an 8-week randomized controlled trial with a 1-month follow-up among 665 assigned young adults with mild-to-moderate symptoms of anxiety or depression recruited via Prolific Academic. Participants were randomized to guided journaling plus mood check, unguided journaling plus mood check, mood check only, or passive control. Available follow-up PROMIS outcomes from 423 participants contributed to the intention-to-treat models. Part II comprised exploratory, non-preregistered analyses of more than 12,000 self-initiated mood observations and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. Selected behavioral dynamics were examined in an independent general-population dataset of 16,630 users. Results: Of 665 assigned participants, 158 (23.8%) were not invited to follow-up because of incomplete onboarding/linkage or administrative issues; 84 (12.6%) were invited but provided no follow-up outcomes. Overall, 423 (63.6%) provided at least one follow-up outcome, with similar availability across conditions (61.5-65.1%). Primary contamination-corrected analyses excluded nine passive-control participants who used the study app and yielded small anxiety estimates favoring journaling, with the largest arm-level estimate observed for guided journaling at week 12 (Cohen d=0.25). Secondary pooled estimates were approximately d=0.16 at week 8 and d=0.19 at week 12. Neither the arm-level nor pooled comparisons survived correction for multiple comparisons. Complementary Bayesian estimates were directionally consistent with lower anxiety but indicated substantial uncertainty regarding effect magnitude. We found no evidence of benefit for depression or functional impairment. In Part II, classifier-derived high-risk signals were more common among younger users (odds ratio 0.81 per year of age; P=.013). Classifier-derived distress and self-reported energy varied by time of day, and mood and risk states exhibited short-term persistence and escalation patterns. Selected behavioral dynamics were reproduced in the independent general-population dataset, although absolute rates differed between samples. Conclusions: The randomized trial yielded small, uncertain anxiety estimates favoring journaling, but these did not establish clinical benefit as no comparison survived statistical correction for multiple comparisons. No benefit was demonstrated for depression or functional impairment. Separately, the exploratory behavioral analyses showed that privacy-preserving longitudinal journaling data could be used to characterize reproducible temporal patterns in mood and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. These findings support further evaluation of digital journaling as a behavioral measurement and risk-signal characterization platform and motivate future trials of more targeted guided-journaling approaches matched to specific symptoms or therapeutic mechanisms. The study also highlights opportunities and procedural challenges in online panel-based digital trials. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07126275.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：数字日记既可作为低强度心理健康干预手段，也可作为纵向行为数据的来源。其临床效果及其在隐私保护条件下进行行为表型分析和风险信号特征描述的潜力需要分别评估。目的：本研究评估了引导式和非引导式数字日记的临床效果，并探讨纵向日记数据能否刻画情绪以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号中的可重复模式。方法：第一部分是一项为期8周的随机对照试验，随访1个月，纳入665名通过Prolific Academic招募的、伴有轻至中度焦虑或抑郁症状的指定年轻成人。参与者被随机分配至引导式日记加情绪检查、非引导式日记加情绪检查、仅情绪检查或被动对照组。来自423名参与者的可用随访PROMIS结局纳入了意向性治疗模型。第二部分包括对超过12,000条自我发起的情绪观察以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号进行的探索性、非预注册分析。所选行为动力学在一个由16,630名用户组成的独立一般人群数据集中进行了检验。结果：在665名指定参与者中，158名（23.8%）因入组/链接不完整或行政问题未被邀请参加随访；84名（12.6%）被邀请但未提供随访结局。总体而言，423名（63.6%）提供了至少一项随访结局，各条件下的可用性相似（61.5-65.1%）。主要污染校正分析排除了9名使用了研究应用的被动对照参与者，产生了有利于日记的小幅焦虑估计值，其中引导式日记在第12周观察到最大的组别水平估计值（Cohen d=0.25）。次要合并估计在第8周约为d=0.16，在第12周约为d=0.19。组别水平和合并比较均未通过多重比较校正。补充的贝叶斯估计在方向上与较低的焦虑一致，但表明效应量的不确定性较大。我们未发现对抑郁或功能损害有益的 evidence。在第二部分中，分类器衍生的高风险信号在较年轻用户中更为常见（每增加一岁比值比为0.81；P=.013）。分类器衍生的困扰和自我报告的能量随时间变化，情绪和风险状态表现出短期持续性和升级模式。所选行为动力学在独立一般人群数据集中得到重现，尽管样本间的绝对率不同。结论：该随机试验产生了有利于日记的小幅、不确定的焦虑估计值，但这些结果并未确立临床获益，因为没有任何比较通过多重比较的统计校正。未证明对抑郁或功能损害有益。另外，探索性行为分析显示，隐私保护条件下的纵向日记数据可用于刻画情绪以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号中的可重复时间模式。这些发现支持进一步评估数字日记作为行为测量和风险信号特征描述平台，并推动未来开展针对特定症状或治疗机制的更有针对性引导式日记方法的试验。该研究还强调了在线面板数字试验中的机遇和程序性挑战。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07126275。

papers.title: Quantifying Academic Risk Factors for Student Depression Using WHO Frameworks: Odds Ratios, SHAP Explainability, and Tipping Point Analysis
papers.translated_title: 量化学生抑郁的学术风险因素：基于WHO框架的优势比、SHAP可解释性与临界点分析
papers.author: Ahmed, T.
papers.summary: Depression has become a serious concern for students worldwide. Aligned with the WHO Helping Adolescents Thrive (HAT) Guidelines and the Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) model, this study isolates five academically relevant factors- academic pressure, work/study hours, study satisfaction, sleep duration, and financial stress- from a dataset of 27,880 university students in India and quantifies their associations with depression. Unlike prior work that maximises classification accuracy, this study prioritises interpretability: logistic regression provides odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals, Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost rank predictors by feature importance, and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values extend the analysis to individual-level risk explanation. Sleep Duration is encoded as an ordinal integer (0-3) preserving its natural order, and Spearman correlations are computed on the original 27,880-row dataset prior to any resampling. SMOTE oversampling was applied exclusively to the training set, and performance was evaluated on the original imbalanced test set (n = 5,576). Both ensemble models achieve approximately 77-78% accuracy and an AUC of 0.845, confirmed by 5-fold pipeline cross-validation (CV AUC [~] 0.843). Academic pressure is the dominant risk factor (OR = 2.271; RF importance = 0.481; mean |SHAP| = 0.174), while study satisfaction (OR = 0.796) and sleep duration (OR = 0.835) are protective. Interaction analysis reveals how depression risk is amplified by low sleep, high financial stress, and extended study hours: under average conditions, the 50% risk threshold is crossed at Academic Pressure {approx} 3.04, and under compounded adverse conditions, this tipping point shifts to even lower pressure values. These findings provide data-driven thresholds aligned with WHO-endorsed modifiable determinants to support early detection and institutional counselling.
papers.translated_summary: 抑郁已成为全球学生面临的严重问题。本研究依据世界卫生组织《帮助青少年茁壮成长（HAT）指南》与健康社会决定因素（SDoH）模型，从印度27,880名大学生数据集中分离出五个与学业相关的因素——学业压力、工作/学习时长、学习满意度、睡眠时长和经济压力——并量化其与抑郁的关联。与以往追求分类准确率最大化的研究不同，本研究优先考虑可解释性：逻辑回归提供比值比（OR）及95%置信区间，随机森林（RF）和XGBoost按特征重要性对预测变量排序，SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）值将分析扩展至个体层面的风险解释。睡眠时长被编码为有序整数（0-3）以保留其自然顺序，Spearman相关在任何重采样之前基于原始27,880行数据集计算。SMOTE过采样仅应用于训练集，性能在原始不平衡测试集（n = 5,576）上评估。两个集成模型均达到约77-78%的准确率和0.845的AUC，并经5折流水线交叉验证确认（CV AUC [~] 0.843）。学业压力是主要风险因素（OR = 2.271；RF重要性 = 0.481；平均|SHAP| = 0.174），而学习满意度（OR = 0.796）和睡眠时长（OR = 0.835）具有保护作用。交互分析揭示了低睡眠、高经济压力和延长学习时间如何放大抑郁风险：在平均条件下，50%风险阈值在学业压力约为3.04时被跨越，而在复合不利条件下，该临界点偏移至更低的压力值。这些发现提供了与WHO认可的可改变决定因素相一致的数据驱动阈值，可支持早期识别和机构心理咨询。

papers.title: The development and psychometric evaluation of the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
papers.translated_title: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征活动后症状量表（PASS）的编制与心理测量学评价
papers.author: Horton, M.
papers.summary: Purpose: To develop and psychometrically evaluate a new scale measuring post-exertional malaise in people with myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)/ chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS). Methods: A draft scale was co-produced with patient and clinician advisory groups. After extensive pilot testing, adults with ME/CFS completed the Post Activity Symptom Scale online and repeated it two weeks later to assess test-retest reliability and sensitivity to change. Rasch analysis assessed each domain for unidimensionality, targeting, internal reliability, item fit and local dependency. Then Rasch-transformed interval data and parametric statistics were used to assess criterion-related and discriminant validity (by comparison with measures of physical health and ME/CFS severity), test-retest reliability and minimal detectable difference. Results: The item regarding delay in PEM onset was an under-discriminating misfit anomaly which was inconsistent with the remaining PASS items. When this was removed, the PASS was a unidimensional, psychometrically robust scale. Criterion-related validity (r=0.58, p<0.001) was moderate and highly significant, discriminant validity (p<0.001) and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) were excellent. The minimal detectable difference was 1.93/100. Participants found the PASS easy to complete, comprehensive and relevant. Conclusion: The Post Activity Symptom Scale is a valid, reliable, sensitive measure of people of PEM in ME/CFS
papers.translated_summary: 目的：开发并心理测量学评估一个测量肌痛性脑脊髓炎（ME）/慢性疲劳综合征（CFS）患者活动后不适的新量表。方法：与患者和临床医生顾问组共同制作量表草案。经过广泛试点测试后，ME/CFS成人患者在线完成活动后症状量表，并在两周后重测，以评估重测信度和变化敏感性。Rasch分析评估每个领域的单维性、目标性、内部信度、条目拟合和局部依赖性。然后使用Rasch转换的区间数据和参数统计评估效标关联效度和区分效度（通过与身体健康和ME/CFS严重程度测量比较）、重测信度和最小可检测差异。结果：关于PEM发作延迟的条目是一个区分度不足的失拟异常项，与其余PASS条目不一致。移除该条目后，PASS成为一个单维、心理测量学稳健的量表。效标关联效度（r=0.58，p<0.001）为中等且高度显著，区分效度（p<0.001）和重测信度（ICC = 0.81）极佳。最小可检测差异为1.93/100。参与者认为PASS易于完成、全面且相关。结论：活动后症状量表是测量ME/CFS患者PEM的有效、可靠、敏感的工具。

papers.title: Success Among Ethnic Minorities and International Medical Graduates in UK Medical Speciality Recruitment: A Longitudinal Analysis of NHS England Data (2021-2025)
papers.translated_title: 英国医学专科招聘中少数族裔与国际医学毕业生的成功情况：对英格兰国民医疗服务体系数据（2021-2025）的纵向分析
papers.author: Hum, R. M.
papers.summary: BackgroundWhile overall application volume by ethnic minority doctors into UK postgraduate medical training has expanded significantly, workforce diversity varies substantially across specialties. Previous reports have suggested that doctors from certain ethnic backgrounds and international medical graduates (IMGs) experience lower likelihoods of securing training posts, but granular longitudinal evaluations across all specialty training levels and recruitment stages remained limited. Therefore, this study evaluates longitudinal trends in self-reported ethnicity and country of qualification across postgraduate medical training in England between 2021 and 2025, maps specialty representation, and tests the hypothesis that recruitment success rates differ significantly between ethnic minority and White baseline applicants. MethodsWe conducted a retrospective national longitudinal analysis of mandatory NHS specialty recruitment data across England from 2021 to 2025, encompassing over 300,000 applications across ST1/CT1 (entry-level) and ST3+ (higher specialty) pathways. Applicants were categorised into census-aligned broad and granular ethnic groups, alongside IMG classifications. Unadjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals were calculated using White graduates and internal sub-ethnic baselines as comparators. Specialty-level ecological correlations (Spearmans rho) were performed to evaluate whether international workforce reliance moderated ethnic recruitment disparities. ResultsBetween 2021 and 2025, applicant volume expanded rapidly, with ethnic minority applicants and IMGs comprising numerical majorities. However, Asian and Black applicants experienced substantially lower odds of receiving training offers compared to White baseline applicants across multiple high-volume specialties (e.g., emergency medicine and anaesthetics at ST1, where Black applicants faced multi-fold reductions in success odds: OR 0.03 to 0.05, p<0.001). Granular analyses revealed notable intra-ethnic heterogeneity, including lower success among Pakistani and Bangladeshi applicants compared to Indian applicants. Furthermore, UK graduates maintained higher offer success than IMGs across most specialties. Ecological correlations demonstrated that higher international applicant reliance was moderately and significantly associated with wider recruitment disparities at higher training levels for Black applicants {rho}=-0.43, p=0.019). ConclusionsCentralised medical recruitment in England exhibits some persistent ethnic and international qualification disparities despite rising application diversity. The findings highlight the necessity of disaggregating ethnic groups and addressing subjective evaluation vulnerabilities within multi-stage recruitment processes to foster equity. papers.title: Development of a deep learning model for glomerulus detection and segmentation in kidney histopathology images
papers.translated_title: 开发用于肾脏组织病理学图像中肾小球检测和分割的深度学习模型
papers.author: Tosaki, T.
papers.summary: BackgroundEstimation of nephron number, an indicator of renal reserve, requires quantitative assessment of glomerular number and size in kidney biopsy specimens. We aimed to develop an automated system for quantitative measurement of glomerular areas from clinical kidney biopsy images, across diverse kidney diseases. MethodsWe developed a two-stage deep learning system combining Faster R-CNN for glomerular detection in whole-slide images (WSIs) and DeepLabV3+ for segmentation. Of 114 kidney biopsies (228 WSIs), 104 were used for model development and 10 for independent final evaluation. Agreement was assessed using the F1-score for detection, the Dice coefficient for segmentation, and the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for glomerular area measurement. Analysis was performed at 40x total magnification (2.331 m/pixel) and validated against 400x images. ResultsIn the independent evaluation set, the artificial intelligence (AI) model achieved a mean F1-score of 0.851 for detection, compared with 0.888 among experts. For segmentation, the Dice coefficient was 0.959 {+/-} 0.011 and the per-pair ICC (2,1) for area measurement was 0.989 {+/-} 0.009; both were comparable to inter-expert agreement. Bland-Altman analysis showed a mean bias of -344 m{superscript 2} (95% limits of agreement, -1904 to 1216 m{superscript 2}) between 40x and 400x measurements. ConclusionThe two-stage model achieved glomerular segmentation and area measurement comparable to expert agreement in independent clinical data, with detection performance approaching inter-expert agreement, and provided reliable measurements at low magnification. This automated approach may facilitate large-scale quantitative kidney pathology and nephron number estimation from clinical kidney biopsies.

papers.title: The effect of carotid atherosclerosis and revascularization on cognition and dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 颈动脉粥样硬化与血运重建对认知和痴呆的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Box, C. V. J.
papers.summary: Background: Carotid artery atherosclerosis may accelerate cognitive decline and increase dementia risk, but evidence is fragmented and inconsistent, and benefit of revascularization on cognitive outcomes uncertain. Methods: We systematically searched Medline, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Central Register, and Google Scholar for articles published until 11 November 2024, reporting change in cognition or dementia incidence in relation to carotid artery intima-media thickness, plaque, stenosis, and revascularization procedures. We excluded studies that investigated people with dementia, lacked a reference group, or had post-intervention follow-up <30 days. We additionally included new data from the Rotterdam Study, and results from the recent CREST-2 trial. Two independent reviewers extracted study data. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed if data allowed. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, Cochrane Risk of Bias, and ROBINS-I. Results: Of 5592 records identified, 97 studies were eligible, including 43 observational studies (N=100,326) and 54 intervention studies (N=15788, 6 randomized controlled trials). In observational studies, mostly among stroke-free individuals, intima-media thickness was associated with higher dementia risk (hazard ratio per 1-SD increase: 1.07, 95%CI 1.01-1.13; I2=24.8%; 5 studies), as was presence of 50-100% asymptomatic steno-occlusive disease (hazard ratio: 1.48, 95%CI 1.06 -2.07; I2=0.0%, 3 studies). Cognitive outcomes were too heterogeneous for meta-analysis, but 11/20 observational studies reported a significant association between carotid atherosclerosis and global cognition. In non-randomized intervention studies, carotid revascularization improved global cognition (standardized mean difference: 0.73, 95%CI 0.37 -1.09; I2=89.8%), but all studies were at high risk of bias, and heterogeneity was only partially explained by intervention type and study characteristics in meta-regression. Suggested benefit of stenting on cognition among Chinese patients (Standardized effect: 0.86 [0.57-1.16], 197 patients; and 1.09 [0.64-1.53], 90 patients, 2 trials) was not observed in the larger CREST-2 trial (Standardized effect: 0.03 [-0.09 to 0.15] and 0.02 [-0.09 to 0.14]), nor in post-hoc analyses of cognition in the ACAS trial and long-term dementia risk in ACST-1 (HR: 0.98 [0.75-1.28]). Conclusions: Carotid atherosclerosis is associated with increased risk of dementia. Current evidence does not support carotid revascularization for prevention of cognitive decline or dementia.

papers.title: Genetic effects on serum and urine metabolites across ancestries and their links to disease
papers.translated_title: 遗传对跨祖先血清和尿液代谢物的影响及其与疾病的关联
papers.author: Steinbrenner, I.
papers.summary: Genome-wide association studies of the metabolome have predominantly examined European-ancestry populations using a single biofluid, constraining both the discovery of metabolite quantitative trait loci (mQTLs) and the resolution of causal variant finemapping. Here, we report a multi-ancestry genome-wide association study of 1,955 serum and urine metabolites in 4,431 European American and African American participants from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities study. We identify 969 mQTLs for 553 metabolites, 30% unreported in studies of matched biofluid and ancestry, and replicate 91-99% of testable mQTLs in two independent cohorts. In the African American sample with balanced sample sizes, 36% of metabolites with mQTLs are serum-specific, 39% urine-specific, and 25% shared, demonstrating complementary genetic architecture. Only 23 of 632 candidate ancestry-specific mQTLs show heterogeneous effects beyond variant availability and power, yet allele frequency differences expose functional variants such as an SLC28A1 splice variant, virtually absent in Europeans, that increases urine uridine excretion, implicating impaired CNT1-mediated renal nucleoside reabsorption. Multi-ancestry finemapping improves credible set resolution, and colocalization with the Million Veteran Program phenome links the catalog to cardiometabolic, kidney and liver traits consistent with prioritized gene function. Integrating biofluids and ancestries enhances genetic discovery and mechanistic characterization of the human metabolome.
papers.translated_summary: 代谢组的全基因组关联研究主要使用单一生物体液在欧洲血统人群中进行，这限制了对代谢物数量性状位点（mQTLs）的发现以及因果变异精细定位的分辨率。在此，我们报告了一项多血统全基因组关联研究，基于动脉粥样硬化风险社区研究中4，431名欧洲裔美国人和非裔美国人参与者的1，955种血清和尿液代谢物。我们鉴定了553种代谢物的969个mQTLs，其中30%在匹配生物体液和血统的研究中未见报道，并在两个独立队列中重复验证了91-99%可测试的mQTLs。在样本量均衡的非裔美国人样本中，具有mQTLs的代谢物中36%为血清特异性，39%为尿液特异性，25%为共享，展示了互补的遗传架构。632个候选血统特异性mQTLs中仅23个显示出超越变异可用性和统计效力的异质性效应，然而等位基因频率差异揭示了功能性变异，如一个在欧洲人中几乎不存在的SLC28A1剪接变异，该变异增加尿苷排泄，暗示CNT1介导的肾脏核苷重吸收受损。多血统精细定位提高了可信集分辨率，与百万退伍军人计划表型的共定位将该目录与心脏代谢、肾脏和肝脏性状相关联，与优先基因功能一致。整合生物体液和血统增强了人类代谢组的遗传发现和机制表征。

papers.title: Room-Aware Transformer for Activities of Daily Living Recognition in Adults with Mild Neurocognitive Disorder Using Ambient Sensors: Development and Evaluation Study
papers.translated_title: 面向轻度神经认知障碍成人日常生活活动识别的房间感知Transformer基于环境传感器的研究：开发与评估
papers.author: Abdalnabi, N.
papers.summary: ABSTRACT Background: Unobtrusive recognition of activities of daily living (ADLs) from ambient sensors may support longitudinal assessment of everyday functioning in adults with mild neurocognitive disorder (mild NCD). However, real-world activity recognition is complicated by heterogeneous home layouts, sensor configurations, routines, and class distributions. Objective: This study evaluated whether a room-aware Transformer that preserves location-specific sensor structure improves participant-level ADL recognition relative to a global Transformer and a stacked unidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) network. Methods: Following pilot feasibility testing with two adult volunteers, we analyzed five homes of adults with mild NCD, comprising 92,765 minute-level observations across 67 annotated home-days. Motion, temperature, illuminance, humidity, and door-contact data were aligned to participant activity logs. The original labels were harmonized into eight categories. Models were developed separately for each home using 10-, 30-, and 60-minute windows. Complete calendar days were assigned to mutually exclusive training, validation, and chronological test sets, and no sequence crossed a day or partition boundary. The same partitions and evaluation procedures were used for all three architectures. Performance was assessed on held-out test days using accuracy, per-class F1 score, and micro- and macro-averaged one-versus-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: The room-aware Transformer achieved the highest or tied accuracy in 9 of 15 home-window comparisons. Its accuracy ranged from 0.27 to 0.57, micro-AUC from 0.57 to 0.82, and macro-AUC from 0.54 to 0.78. Across the 15 settings, mean accuracy was similar for the room-aware and global Transformers and higher than for the LSTM. Mean micro-AUC and macro-AUC were marginally higher for the global Transformer than for the room-aware Transformer. The room-aware model showed its clearest gains in selected contexts, including Homes C and E at 10 minutes and Home A at 60 minutes, but no architecture or temporal window was uniformly optimal. Sleep/Rest was the most consistently recognized activity, whereas low-support activities frequently had low F1 scores despite moderate or high AUC values. Conclusions: Room-specific feature processing provided context-dependent gains in participant-level ADL classification, particularly for accuracy in several home-window settings. The marked variation across homes, activities, and temporal windows supports personalized model development, class-sensitive evaluation, and validation in larger and more diverse residential samples before clinical use. Keywords: activities of daily living; mild neurocognitive disorder; ambient sensors; deep learning; artificial intelligence

papers.title: Cardiovascular hospital demand projections for Suriname up to 2050 with implications for health system planning
papers.translated_title: 苏里南至2050年心血管医院需求预测及其对卫生系统规划的影响
papers.author: Dhanpat, R. A.
papers.summary: Abstract This study developed a data-driven decision-support framework to project annual hospital admissions and in-hospital mortality for ischemic heart disease (IHD) and cerebrovascular disease in Suriname from 2023 through 2050. Using retrospective discharge data from 2013-2022 across three major public hospitals--accounting for approximately 71.8% of national admissions--historical trends were analyzed using log-linear regression across six age groups. Population projections relied on the UN World Population Prospects 2024 Revision. Future admissions and deaths were modelled across five policy pathways: status quo, current HEARTS, strengthened HEARTS, full HEARTS targets, and full HEARTS combined with improved hospital survival, with uncertainty assessed via 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations. Results showed that admission rates increased for most age groups between 2013 and 2022. Under the status quo pathway, combined cardiovascular admissions are projected to reach 15,592 in 2030, 30,772 in 2040, and 62,643 in 2050. Compared to the status quo in 2050, projected admissions would drop to 58,073 under current HEARTS, 41,690 under strengthened HEARTS, and 27,469 under full HEARTS--representing median reductions of 6.0%, 33.5%, and 56.1%, respectively. Additionally, projected 2050 deaths would decrease from 2,644 under the status quo to 1,155 under full HEARTS, and further to 924 with improved hospital survival. Cardiovascular hospital demand could rise substantially if historical trends continue, impacting health-system capacity. While not causal estimates or precise forecasts, these modelled pathways illustrate how routine health data can create a transparent framework to guide cardiovascular prevention, resource allocation, and health-system planning in Suriname.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 本研究开发了一个数据驱动的决策支持框架，用于预测2023年至2050年苏里南缺血性心脏病（IHD）和脑血管疾病的年度住院人数及院内死亡率。利用2013—2022年三家主要公立医院（约占全国住院量的71.8%）的回顾性出院数据，采用对数线性回归对六个年龄组的历史趋势进行分析。人口预测依据联合国《世界人口展望2024年修订版》。未来住院人数和死亡人数在五种政策路径下进行建模：维持现状、当前HEARTS、强化HEARTS、全面HEARTS目标，以及全面HEARTS结合改善院内生存率，并通过10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟评估不确定性。结果显示，2013年至2022年间大多数年龄组的住院率呈上升趋势。在维持现状路径下，预计合并心血管住院人数将在2030年达到15,592例，2040年达到30,772例，2050年达到62,643例。与2050年维持现状相比，当前HEARTS路径下预计住院人数将降至58,073例，强化HEARTS路径下降至41,690例，全面HEARTS路径下降至27,469例——中位降幅分别为6.0%、33.5%和56.1%。此外，2050年预计死亡人数将从维持现状路径下的2,644例降至全面HEARTS路径下的1,155例，若结合改善院内生存率则进一步降至924例。若历史趋势持续，心血管住院需求可能大幅上升，对卫生系统承载能力造成影响。尽管这些并非因果估计或精确预测，但所建模的政策路径展示了如何利用常规卫生数据构建透明框架，以指导苏里南的心血管预防、资源配置和卫生系统规划。

papers.title: Human-centered design can optimize operational details of an implementation strategy: Experiences from a peer-based hypertension medication delivery program in western Kenya
papers.translated_title: 以人为中心的设计可以优化实施策略的运营细节：来自肯尼亚西部一项基于同伴的高血压药物递送项目的经验
papers.author: Vedanthan, R.
papers.summary: Background: Human-centered design (HCD) is a co-creation approach that is increasingly being utilized by implementation science researchers to engage key stakeholders in developing contextually appropriate health interventions and implementation strategies. The exact role of HCD in implementation research, however, remains uncertain. We describe the process, outcome, and experiences of using HCD to develop the operational details of an implementation strategy based on a pre-existing scaffolding that consisted of combining community-based peer medication delivery with health information technology (HIT) to improve medication adherence among hypertension patients in rural western Kenya. Methods: A design team of 22 members was formed representing key stakeholders: hypertension patients, healthcare workers, pharmacists, peers, HIT personnel, policy/program leaders, and implementation researchers. We conducted six meetings utilizing established HCD principles and processes (inspiration, brainstorming, conceptualization, creation, iteration, and finalization), aimed at developing a final implementation strategy with full operational details. Quantitative assessment of acceptability and appropriateness was conducted among healthcare workers, patients, and peers, using the Acceptability of Intervention Measure and Intervention Appropriateness Measure. Results: The design team developed key operational details across five domains: peer recruitment, training and monitoring; HIT; medication delivery; medication payment; and stakeholder identification. Acceptability and appropriateness scores (maximum of 20) were favorable among all participants, but mean scores were notably higher among patients with hypertension (19.3, 19.2) and peers (19.2, 19.2) compared to healthcare workers (17.7, 17.3). Specific recommendations were made to improve the acceptability and appropriateness of the strategy. These findings were subsequently used to develop a final iteration of the implementation strategy. Conclusion: HCD was feasible and useful in optimizing the operational details of our implementation strategy, aligning it with the healthcare goals and needs of the community. It allowed end-users to co-create with researchers, ultimately yielding high pre-implementation acceptability and appropriateness, which we anticipate will ultimately enhance implementation success.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：以人为本的设计（HCD）是一种共同创造方法，越来越多地被实施科学研究者用于让关键利益相关者参与制定符合情境的卫生干预措施和实施策略。然而，HCD在实施研究中的确切作用仍不确定。我们描述了使用HCD在既有框架基础上制定实施策略操作细节的过程、结果和体验，该框架将社区同伴药物配送与卫生信息技术（HIT）相结合，以改善肯尼亚西部农村高血压患者的服药依从性。方法：成立了一个由22名成员组成的设计团队，代表关键利益相关者：高血压患者、卫生工作者、药剂师、同伴、HIT人员、政策/项目领导者和实施研究者。我们召开了六次会议，运用既定的HCD原则和流程（启发、头脑风暴、概念化、创造、迭代和最终确定），旨在制定具有完整操作细节的最终实施策略。使用干预措施可接受性量表和干预措施适当性量表，对卫生工作者、患者和同伴进行了可接受性和适当性的定量评估。结果：设计团队在五个领域制定了关键操作细节：同伴招募、培训和监测；HIT；药物配送；药物支付；以及利益相关者识别。所有参与者的可接受性和适当性得分（最高20分）均良好，但高血压患者（19.3，19.2）和同伴（19.2，19.2）的平均得分明显高于卫生工作者（17.7，17.3）。提出了改善该策略可接受性和适当性的具体建议。这些发现随后被用于制定实施策略的最终迭代版本。结论：HCD在优化我们实施策略的操作细节方面是可行且有用的，使其与社区的卫生目标和需求相一致。它使最终用户能够与研究者共同创造，最终产生了较高的实施前可接受性和适当性，我们预计这将最终提高实施成功率。
